I’d implement this as an opt-in default change for **unmentioned follow-up intent parsing**.

Current behavior is enabled by default in several places:

- [`agent-entrypoint.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-entrypoint.yml#L53-L87) wakes the router for unmentioned comments on `agent`-labeled issues/PRs unless `AGENT_FOLLOWUP_INTENT_MODE` is `disabled`/`false`, and passes `agent-label` when unset.
- [`agent-router.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L172-L220) uses the same unset default before resolving the answer provider and extracting context.
- [`followup-intent.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/followup-intent.ts#L17-L27) parses an empty mode as `agent-label`.
- Tests currently assert that unset mode enables implicit follow-ups, e.g. [`followup-intent.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/followup-intent.test.ts#L10-L16) and [`extract-context-cli.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/extract-context-cli.test.ts#L1218-L1248).

Proposed change:

1. Make unset `AGENT_FOLLOWUP_INTENT_MODE` resolve to `disabled`.
2. Require explicit `AGENT_FOLLOWUP_INTENT_MODE=agent-label` to enable unmentioned follow-up intent parsing.
3. Update `agent-entrypoint.yml` and `agent-router.yml` so the broad wake-up and provider setup only happen when the mode is explicitly `agent-label`.
4. Update `parseFollowupIntentMode("")` to return `disabled`, while keeping `agent-label`, `disabled`, and `false` valid.
5. Update docs in [`configuration-list.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md#L11), [`supported-workflows.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/usage/supported-workflows.md#L228), and [`request-lifecycle.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/request-lifecycle.md#L9).
6. Update tests so default unmentioned comments are ignored, and add/keep an explicit `agent-label` test proving opt-in still works.

Validation should run the focused `.agent` tests for follow-up context and workflow envelope behavior, then the normal `.agent` CI lane if time permits.

One clarification before coding: do you mean only **follow-up intent parsing** (`AGENT_FOLLOWUP_INTENT_MODE`), or do you also want model-backed **dispatch triage** for plain `@sepo-agent ...` mentions disabled by default?
